title: Hold a permit to possess nuclear material
what: Possessing nuclear material or an associated item needs a permit under the Act.

sources.title: Nuclear Non-Proliferation (Safeguards) Act 1987
sources.quote: 23 Possession of nuclear material or associated item without permit (1) Subject to section 24, a person who, without reasonable excuse: (a) possesses nuclear material, or an associated item, to which Part II applies; and (b) does not, at the time of the possession, hold a permit under section 13 or 16 that authorises the person to possess the material or item, as the case may be; commits an offence against this subsection punishable, upon conviction, by imprisonment for not more than 10 years.

sources.title: Nuclear Non-Proliferation (Safeguards) Act 1987
sources.quote: Director means the Director of Safeguards.
